{{Quote|This is Drophan, security detail five.|Drophan, preparing to report Relin Druur|<ref name="CC" />}}
'''Drophan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warrior serving under the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Saes Rrogon]] aboard the [[Sith dreadnaught|dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] prior to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], shortly before the outbreak of the war, ''Harbinger'' and another [[Starship/Legends|ship]], ''[[Omen]]'', were tasked with [[Mining/Legends|harvesting]] [[Lignan]]&mdash;an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] powerful in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]&mdash;on [[Phaegon III]]'s [[Phaegon III's largest moon|largest moon]]. However, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]] [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|infiltrated]] ''Harbinger'' in an attempt to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] the ship. He was confronted by Drophan, who interrogated Druur and intended to report the intruder. Druur then attacked Drophan, [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitating]] him with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] before the Massassi could make the report.

==Biography==
{{Quote|We need assistance in the landing bay. Something went wrong with the&mdash;''"<br />"''Who is your superior?|Relin Druur and Drophan|<ref name="CC" />}}
[[File:Saes.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Drophan served the Sith Lord Saes Rrogon (pictured).]]
Drophan was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] leading up to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. He served as a security [[Officer/Legends|officer]] under the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Saes Rrogon]], aboard Rrogon's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Sith dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']].<ref name="CC" /> In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] sent ''Harbinger'' and another [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] dreadnaught, ''[[Omen]]'', on a mission to find [[Lignan]], a rare [[Ore/Legends|ore]] that was very powerful in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], for use during the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire's]] upcoming invasion of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CC" />

The Sith eventually located a large deposit of Lignan on the [[Phaegon III's largest moon|largest moon]] of [[Phaegon III]] in the [[Phaegon system/Legends|Phaegon system]]. As ''Harbinger'' and ''Omen'' [[Mining/Legends|harvested]] the ore, they were ambushed by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|Infiltrator]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. While ''Harbinger'' sent ten [[Blade-class starfighter|''Blade''-class starfighters]] to assail the fighter, a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Relin Druur]], infiltrated ''Harbinger'' in an attempt to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] the ship's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Force cloak|hide himself]] from the perceptions of the beings he met.<ref name="CC" />

Just outside the ship's [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]], Drophan noticed Druur before the Jedi Master was able to blind him to his appearance. Druur claimed that there was trouble in the landing bay, but the Massassi, suspicious of the Jedi Master's [[flexsuit]]&mdash;a type of [[Environment suit/Legends|environmental suit]]&mdash;inquired as to who his superior was. When Druur gave no answer, Drophan pushed him up against the wall and began to report the interloper's presence via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], but Druur cut him off by claiming that his superior was [[Memit Nadill]]. Drophan was unfamiliar with the name, and Druur informed him that Nadill was a Jedi Master on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirrek]].<ref name="CC" />

Finally realizing the threat that Druur presented, Drophan moved to attack, but Druur [[Telekinesis/Legends|pushed]] him across the corridor and into a wall. Drophan attempted to lunge at Druur with his [[Massassi lanvarok|lanvarok]] weapon, but the Jedi [[Cho sun/Legends|severed]] Drophan's [[Limb/Legends|arm]] and then [[Sai cha/Legends|cut off]] the Massassi's head. Drophan's body was soon discovered and reported to [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Los Dor]] on ''Harbinger''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], who in turn reported the finding to Rrogon. Knowing that the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] cuts on Drophan's body meant that there was a Jedi aboard, Rrogon decided to hunt the Jedi down and present him as a gift to Sadow.<ref name="CC" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Memit who? I do not know that name.''"<br />"''He is a Jedi Master on Kirrek.''"<br />"''A Jedi what?|Drophan and Relin Druur|<ref name="CC" />}}
[[File:Relin-Crosscurrent.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Relin Druur, Drophan's killer]]
Drophan was muscular and spoke in a guttural voice. He wore metal ornamentation on his nose and ears, and also had studs implanted beneath the skin of his forearms, scalp, and biceps. The Massassi carried a [[lanvarok]] slung over his back and a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on his thigh.<ref name="CC" />

Drophan was suspicious of Relin Druur after finding the Jedi and decided to report him. However, Druur was able to distract the Massassi by claiming that his superior was Memit Nadill. Drophan was taken aback, and when Druur told him that Nadill was a Jedi Master, Drophan was too surprised and incredulous to react right away. However, he soon registered the significance of what Druur had said and attacked the Jedi.<ref name="CC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Drophan appeared in ''[[Crosscurrent]]'', a [[2010]] novel written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].<ref name="CC" />
